actionable_steps.citation: Foster firm faith in God — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-09-23
actionable_steps.step: Banish greed from your heart — 'Lobham hithva sukhee bhavathi' (Conquering greed, man realises happiness).

actionable_steps.citation: Foster firm faith in God — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-09-23
actionable_steps.step: Foster the spirit of thyaga (sacrifice) — when you get rid of greed, fill your heart with thyaga, like milk poured into an emptied tumbler.

actionable_steps.citation: Forsake the fete of fancy — SSS Vol 9 (1969), 1969-10-15
actionable_steps.step: Keep the mind away from vice and greed; keep the heart tender and compassionate.

actionable_steps.citation: Love Propels Man Toward God (Alternative Translation) — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-18
actionable_steps.step: Put greed into the fire of divine love — fill your heart with love, and it will turn to ash.

actionable_steps.citation: Fill All Your Actions With Love — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-04-14
actionable_steps.step: Travel light — 'Less luggage more comfort': reduce desires, the luggage of this journey of life.

actionable_steps.citation: Vision Of The Atma — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-02-21
actionable_steps.step: Enjoy Nature according to your need — do not rob Nature of its resources to satisfy your greed.

definition.citation: Recruits for my Army — SSS Vol 5 (1965)
definition.quote: Desire is a storm, greed is a whirlpool, pride is a precipice, attachment is an avalanche, egoism is a volcano. Keep these away so that, when you recite the name of God, or do meditation, they do not disturb the equanimity.

discourses.citation: The gift I like most — SSS Vol 14 (1978 - 80), 1980-11-23
discourses.quote: Greed is the breeding ground of suffering.
They are not eager to accumulate possessions that are superfluous... Greed is the seed-bed of grief.

discourses.citation: Sanctify your life by chanting the divine name — SSS Vol 35 (2002), 2002-02-24
discourses.quote: One with greed can never attain happiness. Man can be happy and make others happy only when he gives up greed.

discourses.citation: Fill the world with love — SSS Vol 28 (1995), 1995-11-18
discourses.quote: There is no worse disease than greed... This greed undermines humanness and turns man into a monster.

make_it_real: Greed is a whirlpool — and the way out is to give. Empty the tumbler of greed, and fill it with sacrifice.
title: Greed

vahinis.quote: The greedy guru and the indolent disciple — both fall into perdition. The guru should not turn into a person who steals wealth (vittha-apahaari) but should be a person who steals hearts!
